description: A platform-independent file lock for Python.

latest_release.body: ### Bug fixes - `AsyncStrictSoftFileLock` with a `poll_interval` below 0.05 seconds now spreads contended retries across a jittered, widening window like `StrictSoftFileLock`, instead of a fixed interval ([#928](https://github.com/tox-dev/filelock/pull/928)) by @feiiiiii5 and @gaborbernat. - `SoftReadWriteLock` on runtimes without `dir_fd` other than Windows, such as GraalPy, now refuses a protocol directory another account owns under a sticky parent, as the other platforms already do ([#940](https://github.com/tox-dev/filelock/pull/940)) by @gaborbernat. - A `SoftFileLease` garbage collected on its own heartbeat thread no longer deadlocks that thread, which left every later `os.fork()` in the process waiting forever ([#949](https://github.com/tox-dev/filelock/pull/949)) by @gaborbernat. - A lock dropped during interpreter shutdown, including a `ReadWriteLock` or `AsyncReadWriteLock`, no longer prints an ignored exception at exit ([#933](https://github.com/tox-dev/filelock/pull/933)) by @kushaldave002 and @gaborbernat. - A lock still referenced when the interpreter exits is released from an `atexit` handler before module teardown, except holds of daemon threads that are still running, and a `thread_local=False` lock while any other thread runs ([#964](https://github.com/tox-dev/filelock/pull/964)) by @gaborbernat. - On Windows, lock paths that differ only in drive letter or UNC share case, such as `C:\work.lock` and `c:\work.lock`, now share one `FileLock` or `SoftReadWriteLock` singleton and trigger `FileLock`'s same-thread deadlock detection ([#929](https://github.com/tox-dev/filelock/pull/929)) by @subotac and @gaborbernat. - Releasing a soft lock whose marker a peer replaced no longer raises `AttributeError` on GraalPy, which lacks `os.pwrite` ([#940](https://github.com/tox-dev/filelock/pull/940)) by @gaborbernat. - `os.fork()` no longer waits forever for a lock transition another thread never finishes; after 30 seconds the child exits with status 70 and the parent continues ([#949](https://github.com/tox-dev/filelock/pull/949)) by @gaborbernat. ### New Contributors - @kushaldave002 made their first contribution in https://github.com/tox-dev/filelock/pull/933 - @subotac made their first contribution in https://github.com/tox-dev/filelock/pull/929 - @hector2394 made their first contribution in https://github.com/tox-dev/filelock/pull/935 [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/filelock/4.2.11/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/filelock/compare/4.2.10...4.2.11)
